boards.title: 10 Late-Night Runs That Explain Sonoma State University
boards.description: Ten under-21-safe food destinations in Rohnert Park and nearby Santa Rosa with currently published late hours.

cards.title: Taco Bell on Redwood Drive
cards.subtitle: 5000 Redwood Dr, Rohnert Park
cards.notes: Use the published location page to confirm availability before leaving; it lists this drive-thru location as open until 3:00 a.m.
cards.short_summary: A Rohnert Park drive-thru with the latest listed Taco Bell closing time.
cards.evidence_claim: Taco Bell’s official Rohnert Park locations page lists the 5000 Redwood Dr location as open until 3:00 a.m. and identifies drive-thru service.
cards.source_title: Taco Bell Restaurants in Rohnert Park, CA
cards.access_notes: Official location page lists this destination as open until 3:00 a.m.; it also lists drive-thru and delivery.

cards.title: Taco Bell on East Cotati Avenue
cards.subtitle: 1700 E Cotati Ave, Rohnert Park
cards.notes: Check the location listing before heading out; its published late listing gives this East Cotati Avenue restaurant a 2:00 a.m. close.
cards.short_summary: An East Cotati Avenue option with official late-night, drive-thru, and delivery listings.
cards.evidence_claim: Taco Bell’s official Rohnert Park locations page lists the 1700 E Cotati Ave location as open until 2:00 a.m., with drive-thru and delivery.
cards.source_title: Taco Bell Restaurants in Rohnert Park, CA
cards.access_notes: Official location page lists this destination as open until 2:00 a.m.; drive-thru and delivery are listed.

cards.title: In-N-Out Burger on Redwood Drive
cards.subtitle: 5145 Redwood Dr, Rohnert Park
cards.notes: For a late pickup, use the restaurant’s posted normal hours: it lists dining and drive-thru availability through 1:00 a.m., later on weekends.
cards.short_summary: A Redwood Drive restaurant listing both dine-in seating and drive-thru service late.
cards.evidence_claim: In-N-Out’s official page lists normal hours of 10:30 a.m.–1:00 a.m. Sunday–Thursday and 10:30 a.m.–1:30 a.m. Friday–Saturday, with dine-in and drive-thru.
cards.access_notes: Official hours: until 1:00 a.m. Sunday–Thursday and 1:30 a.m. Friday–Saturday; dine-in seating and drive-thru are listed.

cards.title: Wingstop on Commerce Boulevard
cards.subtitle: 6420 Commerce Blvd, Rohnert Park
cards.notes: Place a carryout or delivery order within the published window; the official location page lists both services until 1:00 a.m. every day.
cards.short_summary: A Commerce Boulevard option listing 1:00 a.m. carryout and delivery daily.
cards.evidence_claim: Wingstop’s official Rohnert Park page lists carryout and delivery hours of 10:30 a.m.–1:00 a.m. Sunday through Saturday.
cards.access_notes: Official location page lists both carryout and delivery through 1:00 a.m. every day.

cards.title: Habit Burger & Grill at Park Court
cards.subtitle: 630 Park Court, Rohnert Park
cards.notes: Check the day before making the trip: the official listing posts midnight closes Monday–Thursday and 1:00 a.m. closes Friday–Sunday.
cards.short_summary: A Park Court restaurant with posted midnight and weekend 1:00 a.m. closing times.
cards.evidence_claim: Habit Burger’s official Rohnert Park page lists hours until 12:00 a.m. Monday–Thursday and until 1:00 a.m. Friday–Sunday.
cards.access_notes: Official hours: until 12:00 a.m. Monday–Thursday and 1:00 a.m. Friday–Sunday.

cards.title: McDonald’s on Commerce Boulevard
cards.subtitle: 6600 Commerce Blvd, Rohnert Park
cards.notes: Use the restaurant’s published schedule when planning a later stop; its lobby is listed until midnight daily, with Friday and Saturday drive-thru open 24 hours.
cards.short_summary: A Commerce Boulevard location with midnight lobby hours and weekend 24-hour drive-thru service.
cards.evidence_claim: McDonald’s official page lists lobby hours until 12:00 a.m. daily and 24-hour drive-thru service on Friday and Saturday at 6600 Commerce Blvd.
cards.access_notes: Official listing: lobby closes at 12:00 a.m. daily; drive-thru is listed 24 hours Friday and Saturday.

cards.evidence_claim: Jack in the Box’s official Rohnert Park page lists drive-thru hours until 4:00 a.m. and lobby hours until 12:00 a.m.

cards.title: Chipotle on Commerce Boulevard
cards.subtitle: 6325 Commerce Blvd, Rohnert Park
cards.notes: For an evening pickup, use the official store page’s daily schedule, which lists the restaurant open through 11:00 p.m. with in-store pickup and delivery.
cards.short_summary: A Commerce Boulevard restaurant with published 11:00 p.m. daily hours.
cards.evidence_claim: Chipotle’s official page for 6325 Commerce Blvd lists restaurant hours of 10:45 a.m.–11:00 p.m. Monday through Sunday, plus in-store pickup and delivery.
cards.access_notes: Official location page lists daily restaurant hours through 11:00 p.m.; in-store pickup and delivery are available.

cards.title: Domino’s Pizza on East Cotati Avenue
cards.subtitle: 1460 E Cotati Ave, Rohnert Park
cards.notes: Order through the local restaurant page and check its live status before going; the official listing currently shows this location open until midnight.
cards.short_summary: A local pizza restaurant whose official page currently lists a midnight close.
cards.evidence_claim: Domino’s official page for 1460 E Cotati Ave identifies the Rohnert Park location and currently lists it as open until 12:00 a.m.
cards.access_notes: Official local restaurant page currently lists the destination open until 12:00 a.m.; verify live status before departure.

cards.title: In-N-Out Burger on Santa Rosa Avenue
cards.subtitle: 2532 Santa Rosa Ave, Santa Rosa
cards.notes: This nearby Santa Rosa option has posted late hours and both seating and drive-thru; confirm the day’s schedule before making the off-campus trip.
cards.short_summary: A nearby Santa Rosa restaurant listing late dine-in seating and drive-thru service.
cards.evidence_claim: In-N-Out’s official Santa Rosa Avenue page lists normal hours until 1:00 a.m. Sunday–Thursday and 1:30 a.m. Friday–Saturday, with dine-in seating and drive-thru.
cards.access_notes: Official hours: until 1:00 a.m. Sunday–Thursday and 1:30 a.m. Friday–Saturday; dine-in seating and drive-thru are listed.
